Monsoon Activity Brings Rain and Temperature Drops Across India

Monsoon activity has reactivated across several Indian states, bringing much-needed rain and a significant drop in temperatures, particularly in the Delhi-NCR region. While some areas experienced waterlogging and potential crop damage, the rainfall has offered relief from intense heat. Weather agencies have issued alerts for heavy rain and thunderstorms in various parts of the country.
